# gamefabric_steelshield_tokenservices (Data Source)

Data source for a list of Token Services.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get all token services without any filtering.
data "gamefabric_steelshield_tokenservices" "all" {}

# Get token services filtered by labels.
data "gamefabric_steelshield_tokenservices" "platforms_team" {
  label_filter = {
    team = "platforms"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `label_filter` (Map of String) A map of keys and values that is used to filter token services. Only items with all specified labels (exact matches) will be returned.

### Read-Only

- `token_services` (Attributes List) The token services that match the label filter. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--token_services))

<a id="nestedatt--token_services"></a>
### Nested Schema for `token_services`

Read-Only:

- `annotations` (Map of String) Annotations is an unstructured map of keys and values stored on an object.
- `development_mode` (Boolean) Whether the token service runs in development mode. When `true`, the token service returns errors to game clients; when `false`, it hides them.
- `eos` (Attributes List) Epic Online Services (EOS) auth mode configurations, only present in EOS mode. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--token_services--eos))
- `game_name` (String) The name of the game.
- `hostname` (String) The fully-qualified domain name assigned to this token service instance.
- `jwks` (Attributes) JWKS endpoint auth mode configuration, only present in JWKS mode. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--token_services--jwks))
- `labels` (Map of String) A map of keys and values that can be used to organize and categorize objects.
- `name` (String) The unique object name within its scope.
- `platform_key` (String, Sensitive) The platform key used for all platforms.
- `platforms` (Attributes Map) Maps platform names to their game client token verification configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--token_services--platforms))
- `reason` (String) The failure reason. Null when there is no failure.
- `state` (String) The high-level lifecycle state of the token service. One of `Pending`, `Available`, or `Error`.
- `state_last_changed` (String) The timestamp of the last state change, in RFC3339 format.

<a id="nestedatt--token_services--eos"></a>
### Nested Schema for `token_services.eos`

Read-Only:

- `client_id` (String) The EOS client ID.
- `deployment_id` (String) The EOS deployment ID.
- `product_id` (String) The EOS product ID.
- `sandbox_id` (String) The EOS sandbox ID.
- `token_types` (List of String) The accepted EOS token types.


<a id="nestedatt--token_services--jwks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `token_services.jwks`

Read-Only:

- `url` (String) The JWKS endpoint URL.


<a id="nestedatt--token_services--platforms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `token_services.platforms`

Read-Only:

- `game_client_token_keys` (Attributes List) A list of keys used to verify game client tokens for this platform. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--token_services--platforms--game_client_token_keys))

<a id="nestedatt--token_services--platforms--game_client_token_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `token_services.platforms.game_client_token_keys`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String, Sensitive) The key material used to verify tokens.
- `signing_algorithm` (String) The signing algorithm used with this key.
